correctness.rationale: The final claim fixes iid uniform n types, deterministic m_n→∞ with m_n/log n→α∈[0,∞], quantile Q_m(b)=1/n, h=1-(m-1)/b and floor n(b+x/h) draws. The proof explicitly uses exact Poisson mass ratios p_(m-j)(u)/p_(m-1)(u)=(m-1)_(j-1)/u^(j-1). The three q regimes give point mass depth=1, geometric (1-q)q^(j-1), or h-scaled Exp(1). Integrating tail hazard, rare independent marked types after Poissonization, and squeezing monotone depth-tail counts between clock times x±δ with b h²/n→0 establishes the fixed-x marked Poisson limit and compound-Poisson transforms; it does not assert process-in-x convergence. Inspected verify.py checks exact multinomial and Gamma/Poisson finite formulas and is not substituted for asymptotic proof. Potential shortcut for gamma quantile requires a uniform moderate-deviation tail estimate; the stated m h²~2log n and h R_m→1 are consistent with the saddlepoint/gamma lower-tail asymptotics.
